title: Polyethylene Glycol Precipitation for Wastewater Sample Extraction
author: Shannon Fitz
materials: PEG precipitation for wastewater sample concentration

steps.title: Filter and Prepare Wastewater Sample
steps.instruction: Filter the wastewater sample through a coffee filter to remove suspended solids and transfer 40mL of the filtered wastewater into a clean 50 mL tube.

steps.title: Precipitate Nucleic Acids
steps.instruction: Add PEG8000 and NaCl to the sample to reach final concentrations of 10% (w/v) and 0.4 M, respectively.

substeps.instruction: Vortex for 10 minutes (or use a horizontal shaker at high speed).

steps.title: Centrifuge and Collect Precipitate
steps.instruction: Perform a series of centrifugation steps to isolate the precipitate.

substeps.instruction: Immediately centrifuge at 12,000g for 100 min at 4°C.
Remove and discard the supernatant using a serological pipet, leaving approximately 5mL in the tube.
Centrifuge the remaining mixture again at 12,000g for 5 minutes at 4°C.
Carefully remove and discard any residual supernatant.

steps.title: Resuspend Precipitate
steps.instruction: Resuspend the precipitate in a mixture of lysis buffer and water/PBS and transfer to a smaller tube.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 ul of lysis buffer from the extraction kit and 200 ul of nuclease-free water (or 5% PBS) to the precipitate.
Transfer the mixture into a clean 1.5 ml tube.
Vortex at high speed for 10 seconds and centrifuge.

steps.title: Prepare Binding Bead Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the Binding Bead mix for the required number of samples, including a 10% overage.

substeps.instruction: Vortex the Binding Beads vigorously to ensure full resuspension.
Combine 500 ul of Binding solution and 20 ul of Binding beads per sample (Total 520 ul).
Mix well by inversion and store at room temperature.

steps.title: Bind Nucleic Acids to Beads
steps.instruction: Combine the resuspend samples with Proteinase K and the Binding Bead Mix.

substeps.instruction: Add 40 μL of Proteinase K to each sample.
Invert the Binding Bead Mix tube several times to resuspend beads, then add 520 µL of Binding Bead Mix to each sample using a new pipette tip for every sample.
Close samples firmly and shake at 900 rpm for 5 minutes.
Place samples on a magnetic stand for at least 5 minutes, or until all beads have collected.

steps.title: Wash Beads
steps.instruction: Wash the collected beads to remove contaminants.

substeps.instruction: While on the magnetic stand, carefully open tubes and discard the supernatant without disturbing the beads.
Remove samples from the stand, add 1 mL of Wash Buffer to each sample, close tubes, and shake at 800 rpm for 30 seconds.
Place samples on the magnetic stand for 3 minutes (or until beads collect) and discard the supernatant.
Repeat the wash process using 1 mL of 80% ethanol.

steps.title: Elute Nucleic Acid
steps.instruction: Elute the isolated nucleic acid from the beads.

substeps.instruction: Add 50–100 μL of Elution Solution to each sample and close the tubes.
Incubate at 75°C for 5 minutes.
Shake at 800 rpm for 5 minutes.
Place samples on the magnetic stand for 3 minutes (or until beads collect).
Carefully open tubes and transfer the eluates to clean tubes, closing them immediately to prevent evaporation.

steps.title: Store Isolated Nucleic Acid
steps.instruction: Store the isolated nucleic acid based on the required duration.

substeps.instruction: Store at –20°C for up to 6 months.
Store at –80°C for greater than 6 months.
